note: Dashboard version record (10-observability.md: 'A dashboard is not release evidence unless its record identifies the measurement boundary, workload, duration, UTC clock source/offset, exact software versions, sample count, and whether failures or restarts are included.'). Queries are bound to the O2 canonical streams the OTel collector routes to: 'metrics' (OTLP + Flink Prometheus remote-write) and 'logs' (filelog via O2 header routing). Panels render empty until their data source exports; the EXECUTOR OTLP export lands via the telemetry.rs TelemetrySink seam.

dashboards.title: Safe to Trade
dashboards.measurement_boundary: global (operator): execution gate + order flow + data-feed health + system state
dashboards.utc_clock: host UTC; O2 _timestamp; offset panel bound to service clock_offset_ms
dashboards.failures_or_restarts_included: yes — panel 2 (unresolved/unknown) and log tails explicitly capture failures
dashboards.software_versions: OpenObserve v0.91.5-amd64 (compose OPENOBSERVE_IMAGE); dashboard API v8

dashboards.title: Orders and Fills
dashboards.measurement_boundary: execution_partition: order lifecycle, broker confirmations (fills/cancels/rejects), gate state
dashboards.failures_or_restarts_included: yes — reject/unknown panel and executor log tail

dashboards.title: Market Data Ingestion
dashboards.measurement_boundary: instrument: feed throughput, losslessness counters, reconnects, clock offset, subscription completeness
dashboards.workload: ingestion bridge + IngestionService (1,024-instrument / single-connection testing envelope)
dashboards.utc_clock: host UTC; O2 _timestamp; clock-offset panel bound to service clock_offset_ms
dashboards.failures_or_restarts_included: yes — reconnect/epoch panel and ingestion log tail
dashboards.software_versions: OpenObserve v0.91.5-amd64; go-bridge (Go SDK pin GO_ARROW_SDK_VERSION)

dashboards.title: Storage and EOD
dashboards.measurement_boundary: global: Fluss append/fetch latency, checkpoint health, EOD offload state
dashboards.failures_or_restarts_included: yes — checkpoint-failure panel and Fluss log tail
dashboards.software_versions: OpenObserve v0.91.5-amd64; Fluss client pinned in ingestion Cargo/pom

dashboards.title: Position State — Max-One-Active
dashboards.measurement_boundary: instrument_token (16 buckets): max-one-active indefinite block, 4 panels gauge + dropped/passed + cleared + trading_alerts audit
dashboards.workload: SignalJob ActiveSignalFeedbackFunction (Position_State PK instrument_token) + Nautilus Execution Gateway; metrics via flink-metrics-otel -> otel-collector:4318 -> metrics, logs via ComputeAlertLogs -> trading_alerts
dashboards.failures_or_restarts_included: yes — dropped/cleared counters and trading_alerts table capture indefinite-stuck and ADMIN_CLEAR break-glass
dashboards.software_versions: OpenObserve v0.91.5-amd64; SignalJob ActiveSignalFeedbackFunction v1 (Option B strict, no TTL) + Position_State v1 (7 cols, 16 buckets)

dashboards.title: Dedup State — DEC-038
dashboards.measurement_boundary: fingerprint_dedup 16 buckets: dedup table entries/bytes, update rate, Flink cache hit ratio/utilization, cleanup backlog, rehydration latency/failures
dashboards.failures_or_restarts_included: yes — rehydration failures and state-compatibility preflight failures (fail-closed SIG-STATE-002/003)
dashboards.software_versions: OpenObserve v0.91.5-amd64; FlussFingerprintDedupStateStore v1 + SignalJob cache v1

dashboards.title: Security and Platform — Host/Container/JVM/ZK/Swarm
dashboards.measurement_boundary: global+vm_id/container: host CPU/mem/disk/net, container CPU/mem/restarts, JVM heap/GC/threads, ZK quorum, Swarm, credential/TLS/audit
dashboards.workload: node_exporter:9100 per vm_id + cadvisor:8080 per container + OTel Javaagent jvm.* per service_name + filelog/infrastructure + traces
dashboards.failures_or_restarts_included: yes — host alert + JVM heap 85% + ZK quorum loss + infrastructure_logs tail
dashboards.software_versions: OpenObserve v0.91.5-amd64; node_exporter v1.8.2 cadvisor v0.49.1 opentelemetry-javaagent

dashboards.title: Compute and Decision — Backpressure/Checkpoint/DEC-038
dashboards.measurement_boundary: slot: source throughput/lag, watermark, operator busy/idle/backpressure, checkpoint duration/size/failure/restore, decision p99
dashboards.workload: SignalJob (Flink) Prometheus 9249 + Fluss dedup-table + cache metrics via otel-collector:4318
dashboards.failures_or_restarts_included: yes — checkpoint failure/restore, rehydration failure, backpressure/decision p99
dashboards.software_versions: OpenObserve v0.91.5-amd64; Flink 2.2.1 PrometheusReporter + SignalJob v1
